# v0.14

Released 2026-11-08.

## Highlights

- Login now happens in an embedded WebKit view in an always-visible bottom panel, and a
  login is required before Zwift launches; `--skip-login` opts out.
- Cookies persist between runs, and token-endpoint errors are reported instead of hanging.
- The smoke test's Zwift and winetricks downloads are cached, and incomplete installs are
  detected and skipped.
- Feral GameMode support removed.
